_comment: Single source of truth for who Peter is, what Techimpossible sells, and what he is building. scripts/update-seo.js renders this into the homepage Projects list, llms.txt, sitemap.xml and the structured data. Edit here, run `make seo`, and every surface updates together.

site.title: Peter Skaronis
site.tagline: Cybersecurity consultant. vCISO. I write, build things, and help startups with security that works.
site.summary: Personal site of Peter Skaronis — cybersecurity consultant, vCISO, and founder of Techimpossible. Essays on security, compliance and the constraints people do not notice, plus the tools and games he builds.

business.name: Techimpossible
business.description: Cybersecurity and compliance consultancy for growing companies. Audit readiness, security programs that survive contact with a real auditor, and governance for teams shipping AI.

services.name: SOC 2 readiness and audit support
services.description: Get to a SOC 2 report without stalling engineering: scoping, control design, evidence, and support through the external audit.

services.name: ISO 27001 and ISO 42001
services.description: Build an ISMS that passes certification and stays useful afterwards, including AI management systems under ISO 42001.

services.name: HIPAA compliance
services.description: Safeguards, risk analysis and documentation for teams handling protected health information.

services.name: Virtual CISO (vCISO)
services.description: Fractional security leadership: strategy, risk decisions, customer security reviews and board-level reporting.

services.name: AI governance and security
services.description: Policy, risk assessment and controls for companies building with or buying AI, mapped to recognised frameworks.

services.name: Vendor and third-party risk
services.description: Assess suppliers properly, and answer your own customers' security questionnaires without derailing a quarter.

writing.name: Essays
writing.description: Long-form writing on invisible constraints — geographic, economic and psychological — drawn from lived experience rather than advice.

writing.name: Cybersecurity Notes
writing.description: Technical notes on security practice, frameworks and compliance.

writing.name: Archive
writing.description: Every post, grouped by year and month.

projects.name: LifeLens
projects.description: A life reflection and planning tool built around the observation that a life is roughly four thousand weeks. Privacy-first: everything stays in your browser.

projects.name: ThinkLens
projects.description: A thinking tool that applies structured mental models to a decision you are actually facing.

projects.name: Cybersecurity Basics
projects.description: A free interactive assessment and course teaching cybersecurity fundamentals to people who are not security professionals.

projects.name: Claude Skills
projects.description: An open library of Claude Code skills, including a security posture check and the Techimpossible security advisory format.

projects.name: Veridis Quo
projects.description: A retro arcade game — a neon odyssey, built for the pleasure of building it.

projects.name: GRC Refinement
projects.description: A game that teaches governance, risk and compliance estimation by making you do it.

projects.name: Life of a Cybersecurity Consultant
projects.description: A narrative game about the actual day-to-day of consulting in security.

projects.name: Digital Awareness
projects.description: A live demonstration of what a website can infer about you before you have typed anything.

projects.name: Autofill Security
projects.description: Shows how hidden form fields can harvest far more than the data you thought you were giving away.

projects.name: Photography
projects.description: Landscape photography, released free on Unsplash.

reading.name: Library
reading.description: Books read, synced from Goodreads, with notes on some.

reading.name: Quotes
reading.description: A collection of quotes, one surfaced on the homepage each day.
